name: Plan project initialization with independent repository boundaries
original_name: Plan project initialization with independent repository boundaries
description: Deliver a current, validated managed implementation plan from TRD-20260904-2D10A556 for Sys4AI project initialization and Memory System adoption, preserving independent ownership and Git boundaries for Sys4AI and child projects. This is planning and Task tracking only.
definition_of_done: The exact current TRD and live project guidance, architecture, repository boundaries, and protected state are inspected and recorded with source lineage.

A managed draft plan represents all 24 TRD requirements and the current repository clarification with complete forward and reverse task coverage, ordered dependencies, acceptance criteria, verification steps, and explicit unresolved contradictions.
The plan is written only through plan_state.py, reopened with show, and passes structural, coverage, projection, and catalog-index validation.
Only the selected managed planning artifacts and this new Task record are changed; the source TRD, project implementations, repository state, registry, and unrelated work remain preserved.

The final Task Response records current criterion-by-criterion evidence and reports exact plan identity, revision, lifecycle, counts, verification level, and any readiness gate without claiming implementation.
current_summary: Planning deliverable complete and verified at static-check level. PLAN-20260904-7AEB452E revision 2 remains draft with one open readiness question; every implementation task remains planned with no execution evidence. Task, TRD, plan, native goal, Git and runtime lifecycle remain separate.
